card.name: Small linking words after a topic phrase
card.fires_on: Short prepositions (from, for, in, of) that follow a complete topic phrase such as "More on X" or "All this". Common in web encyclopedia link lists and promotional or opinion text.

modes.label: More on X from
modes.description: The word "from" after "More on" plus a topic, introducing a source site in encyclopedia pages.
modes.example: More on Tyburn<< from>> Infoplease: - Tyburn:

modes.label: All this + preposition
modes.description: A preposition right after "All this" in a summing-up sentence.
modes.example: All this<< in>> an easy-to-understand, user-friendly

modes.label: Noun then "for"
modes.description: The word "for" after a noun phrase, meaning for someone or for a group.
modes.example: All of this will mean higher prices<< for>> us urban-dwellers.
